story_clusters.summary: RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that strong economic fundamentals and a better current account deficit (CAD) will help India offset external shocks. He also mentioned that discussions on levying a Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) on UPI payments are "premature" at this stage. Additionally, he announced that the RBI will introduce polymer currency notes starting from the beginning of the next fiscal year.
